title: Church Mission
definition: Church Mission is the calling of the Church to glorify God by making disciples, proclaiming Christ, and displaying the Gospel in word and deed.
summary: The Church is gathered by Christ and sent for His mission.
christFocus: Jesus Christ sends His people as witnesses to His death, resurrection, lordship, and grace.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church Mission teaches that Christ does not redeem people into isolation but into a gathered, accountable, worshiping, serving, and mission-shaped people. The Church belongs to Jesus, is formed by the Gospel, and is strengthened by the Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and Spirit-empowered service.

This doctrine helps believers see the Church as more than a place to attend. It is the household of God, the body of Christ, and a visible witness to the grace, holiness, unity, and truth of the Lord.

The specific emphasis here is the church is gathered by christ and sent for his mission.. A healthy church life displays Christ's care for His people and His mission to the world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people treat church as optional, consumer-driven, or disconnected from discipleship. Church Mission calls believers back to Christ's design for His people, where worship, truth, love, accountability, service, and mission are held together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Participate in church life with humility and faithfulness. Let church mission move you to serve, forgive, gather, pray, give, submit to Scripture, care for others, and help the body of Christ grow in love and maturity.
